checks: SA exit block: 2 pauses of 2× the sinus cycle (1177 ms)
not asked (narrow): narrow OM1 criteria not met (ST depression (J+80) in none ≥ 1 mm horizontal)

lines.rhythm: A P before every QRS, rate under 60: sinus bradycardia.
lines.saBlock: Whole P–QRS complexes drop out; each pause is twice the P–P interval: sinoatrial exit block.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in I, aVL, V5, V6: also true on this ECG.

checks: lbbb: QRS 125 ms

lines.rhythm: Irregularly irregular, no P waves, ventricular rate under 60: atrial fibrillation with a slow ventricular response.
lines.lbbb: QRS ≥ 120 ms, broad notched R in I and V6, deep QS in V1: LBBB.

lines.rhythm: Chaotic, irregular deflections with no identifiable QRS complexes: ventricular fibrillation. Defibrillate.

checks: narrow: ST depression (J+80) in II -1.3, III -1.1, aVF -1.2

lines.rhythm: Regular, a P before every QRS at a normal rate: sinus rhythm.
lines.std: ST depression in II, III, aVF, ST up in aVR: subendocardial ischemia (NSTEMI pattern). It does not localise the artery.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in III, aVF: also true on this ECG.

checks: nsstt: flat T in II aVF V5 V6

lines.rhythm: Irregularly irregular, no P waves, ventricular rate 60–100: atrial fibrillation with a controlled ventricular response.
lines.nsstt: Flat T waves in II, aVF, V5, V6, no territory, no ST depression or Q waves: non-specific ST-T changes.

checks: couplet: 2 ectopic beats (2 wide, 2 premature)
lafb: axis -57°

lines.rhythm: Sawtooth flutter waves at about 300/min, every third one conducted: atrial flutter with 3:1 block.
lines.couplet: Two premature wide complexes in a row: a ventricular couplet (three or more would be non-sustained VT).
lines.lafb: Axis beyond −45° with qR in aVL and rS in II, III, aVF: left anterior fascicular block.

checks: pause: longest P–P 3865 ms (3.5× the usual), 2 escape beat(s)
not asked (rbbb): rbbb criteria not met (QRS 149 ms)
not asked (evolving): evolving pLCx criteria not met (ST elevation in none)

lines.rhythm: A P before every QRS, rate under 60: sinus bradycardia.
lines.sinusPause: A sudden pause with no P wave, not a multiple of the P–P interval, ended by a narrow junctional escape beat (no P before it), then sinus beats resume: sinus pause with junctional escape.
lines.qwaves: Q waves in II, III, aVF, V5, V6: also true on this ECG.

checks: rae: P in II 0.393 mV

lines.rhythm: A P before every QRS, rate over 100: sinus tachycardia.
lines.rae: P taller than 2.5 mm in II: right atrial enlargement.

checks: lafb: axis -62°
not asked (hyper): hyper mLAD criteria not met (T not tall)

lines.rhythm: Irregular, rate over 100, at least three different P-wave shapes with varying PR: multifocal atrial tachycardia.
lines.lafb: Axis beyond −45° with qR in aVL and rS in II, III, aVF: left anterior fascicular block.

checks: nsstt: flat T in V5 V6

lines.rhythm: Irregularly irregular, no P waves, ventricular rate under 60: atrial fibrillation with a slow ventricular response.
lines.nsstt: Flat T waves in V5, V6, no territory, no ST depression or Q waves: non-specific ST-T changes.

checks: AV conduction (engine): high
narrow: ST depression (J+80) in II -1.9, aVF -1.1, V4 -1.3, V5 -2.2, V6 -1.6
lvh: Sokolow 5.05
as is: AV pattern high, not mobitz2

lines.rhythm: Constant PR, then a P suddenly not conducted: Mobitz II.
lines.std: ST depression in II, aVF, V4, V5, V6, ST up in aVR: subendocardial ischemia (NSTEMI pattern). It does not localise the artery.
lines.lvh: S in V1 plus R in V5/V6 ≥ 35 mm: left ventricular hypertrophy.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in I, aVL, V5, V6: also true on this ECG.

lines.rhythm: Regular broad-complex tachycardia without related P waves: ventricular tachycardia.

checks: AV conduction (engine): 2:1
multinarrow: ST depression in II aVF V4 V5 V6, aVR 1.3 mm

lines.rhythm: Every second P is not conducted: 2:1 AV block. 2:1 conduction cannot tell Mobitz I from II, so it is named as the more dangerous one: Mobitz II.
lines.std: Widespread ST depression in II, aVF, V4, V5, V6: diffuse subendocardial ischemia, not one territory. With ST elevation in aVR (1.3 mm): the left main or multivessel pattern (here proximal circumflex, mid LAD narrowed). Urgent: it does not localise to one artery.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in I, II, aVL, aVF, V5, V6: also true on this ECG.

checks: not asked (hyper): hyper pLAD criteria not met (T not tall)
as is: blind read also: old MI septal+anterior+lowLateral

lines.rhythm: Irregularly irregular, no P waves, ventricular rate over 100: atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular response (AF with RVR).
lines.qwaves: Q waves in V2, V3, V4, V5, V6: also true on this ECG.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in III, aVF: also true on this ECG.

checks: lpfb: axis 100°

lines.rhythm: Regular, a P before every QRS at a normal rate: sinus rhythm.
lines.lpfb: Right axis with rS in I and qR in III, no RVH: left posterior fascicular block.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in II, III, aVF: also true on this ECG.

checks: recent: Q waves in II III aVF
as is: recent dRCA: no T inversion yet (Q waves in II III aVF, T inversion in none); Q waves asked

lines.rhythm: A normal P before every QRS with a constant PR, but the RR lengthens and shortens gradually with breathing (more than 120 ms apart): sinus arrhythmia, a normal finding.
lines.qwaves: Q waves in II, III, aVF: old inferior infarct.
lines.std: ST depression in I, aVL: also true on this ECG.

checks: lbbb: QRS 124 ms

lines.rhythm: Regular, a P before every QRS at a normal rate: sinus rhythm.
lines.lbbb: QRS ≥ 120 ms, broad notched R in I and V6, deep QS in V1: LBBB.

lines.rhythm: Regular narrow tachycardia above 200 with no visible P: AVRT, not AVNRT.

checks: evolving: ST elevation in I aVL
lafb: axis -57°
rbbb: QRS 147 ms

lines.rhythm: P waves march through at their own rate, unrelated to a slow regular escape: complete AV block.
lines.ste: ST elevation in I, aVL, past its peak, with Q waves forming: an evolving lateral STEMI, about 4 hours old.
lines.lafb: Axis beyond −45° with qR in aVL and rS in II, III, aVF: left anterior fascicular block.
lines.rbbb: QRS ≥ 120 ms, rsR′ in V1 and a broad S in I and V6: RBBB.
lines.twi: T wave inversion in V2, V3: also true on this ECG.

checks: hypoK: U waves (engine: slow terminal repolarisation)
pvc: 2 ectopic beats (2 wide, 2 premature)

lines.rhythm: Regular, a P before every QRS at a normal rate: sinus rhythm.
lines.hypoK: Flat T waves followed by prominent U waves in V2–V3: hypokalemia.
lines.pvc: An early, wide, bizarre QRS with no P wave before it and a full compensatory pause: premature ventricular complexes.
